jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

ABOUT THE ROLEThis role owns ERC's development assurance processes: how requirements, architecture, validation and verification evidence are produced, traced and released across UAS, system, equipment, item and software level.
You define the framework and make it work on live programmes. Much of the job happens in conversation, so you will spend your time with the engineering teams rather than with documents alone. Your closest counterparts are our Configuration Manager, System Safety and the other teams who apply the process every day.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own ERC's development assurance framework based on ARP4754B and DO-178C
• Write and maintain the Development Assurance, Validation, Verification and Process Assurance Plans
• Define which artefacts and maturity levels each gate requires, from Concept Design through to Entry Into Service
• Assign development assurance levels with System Safety and derive the independence requirements
• Build requirements and V&V workflows and keep traceability consistent across levels
• Sit with the IPTs to understand how engineers actually work before changing how they work
• Guide programmes through gate reviews and process audits, and close the findings

WHAT YOU BRING
• Deep, hands-on experience applying ARP4754A/B in aircraft or UAS development programmes
• Practical command of DO-178C and how software assurance connects to system level
• A track record of defining development processes, not only working within them
• Experience assigning development assurance levels and deriving process requirements from them
• Confident use of requirements management tooling for cross-level traceability
• No hesitation in walking up to people you have not met, asking how they work and getting them on board
• A technical degree in aerospace, mechanical or electrical engineering, and fluent English

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe pulmonary diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Postdoctoral Scientist to join our Vascular Health Cluster within Innovation & Research (I&R).
This position focuses on understanding the role of the pulmonary vasculature in chronic lung diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis (PF) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). While epithelial injury has long been considered a key driver of disease progression, growing evidence highlights the pulmonary endothelium as a critical regulator of vascular remodeling, inflammation, tissue homeostasis, and fibrosis. Aberrant endothelial responses contribute to vascular dysfunction, increased permeability, altered angiogenesis, and pathological tissue remodeling.
As a postdoctoral researcher, you will drive the development of innovative in vivo models and advanced imaging approaches to investigate vascular remodeling and identify new opportunities for therapeutic intervention and drug triaging
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.
To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.
Tasks & responsibilities

- One of your key responsibilities will be to establish, characterize and validate novel in vivo models of pulmonary vascular pathologies, including aberrant angiogenesis, pathological vascular sprouting and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT).
- You will investigate vascular remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis and COPD and define robust, disease-relevant endpoints for mechanistic and pharmacological studies.
- In regard to quantitative vascular assessment, you will develop readouts for aberrant angiogenesis, vascular thickening, pulmonary vascular volume and structural changes within the pulmonary vasculature.
- Moreover, you will apply and further develop high-resolution micro-computed tomography (µCT) of isolated lungs and image-based quantification pipelines for vascular analysis.
- In addition, you will identify and evaluate tissue-based and circulating biomarkers associated with pulmonary vascular pathology and translate preclinical findings into novel therapeutic concepts.
- Furthermore, you will collaborate with internal and external experts, present your findings at scientific meetings and contribute to mentoring students and junior scientists where appropriate.

Requirements

- PhD in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Veterinary Medicine, Imaging Sciences or a related discipline.
- FELASA-B certification or an equivalent qualification that enables independent work with laboratory animals, together with hands-on experience in animal models.
- Experience with µCT imaging and/or advanced image analysis methods; experience with computational imaging or independent programming will be an advantage.
- Solid knowledge of molecular and cellular biology techniques, including flow cytometry (FACS), Western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, and protein and RNA analysis.
- Knowledge of pulmonary diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis and/or COPD; expertise in vascular biology, endothelial cell biology, angiogenesis or fibrosis research will be an advantage.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in written and spoken English; German language skills will be a strong advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.

- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.

- Proven experience in test automation.

- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.
- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).
- Version control experience (Git).
- Proficiency in spoken and written English.
- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.
- Strong teamwork skills.
- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.

Nice to have:

- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

What you’ll do

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about ensuring the cybersecurity of products and solutions in the OT/IACS environment using IEC 62443 and modern cryptographic methods? Join our team and play a key role in defining secure architectures, including the use of strong cryptography, key management, and identity management.

What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package - Access to Siemens share plans - 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family - 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard - Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests - Barrier-free locations

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You’ll make an impact by

- You conduct comprehensive threat and risk analyses for electrification and automation products, subsequently deriving and implementing appropriate protection measures - Building on this, you ensure compliance with relevant standards such as IEC 62443 by guiding and supporting certification processes, including vulnerability assessments for cryptographic algorithms and key management - You provide expert consultation on the secure integration of cryptography into products, advising development teams on the selection and implementation of secure protocols and cryptographic requirements - Additionally, you assess cryptographic risks, develop effective countermeasures, and support audits by ensuring thorough documentation and adherence to internal security and cryptography policies - You are the first point of contact for our regions on security matters and advise customers directly on complex topics

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You hold a master's degree in computer science or electrical engineering with longterm professional experience in cybersecurity- Experience & Skills:- You have deep expertise in modern cryptography, including symmetric, asymmetric, and hybrid methods - You possess in-depth knowledge of cryptographic algorithms (AES, RSA, ECC, SHA-2/3), PKI, certificates (X.509), OCSP, CRL, trust anchors, and relevant standards (NIST, BSI, ETSI) - You are experienced with secure key lifecycle management, secure protocols (TLS, IPsec, SSH, IEC 62351), and post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
- Ways of working: - You demonstrate leadership, adaptability, and effective communication skills when collaborating with cross-functional teams - You are willing to travel occasionally within Germany, in some cases world wide
- Languages: You are proficient in both German and English

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
